verdict.rationale: Databricks' Trust Center compliance page documents a SOC 2 Type II report available to customers and refers to a broader certification portfolio, which gives security review a first-party attestation to work from. The pack does not explicitly name HIPAA or PCI, so only about a third of the story is concretely evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit HIPAA attestation or BAA documentation, explicit PCI DSS attestation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of report access.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, compliance attestations (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI) are documented so security review does not stall the rollout

citations.quote: documents attestations including a SOC 2 Type II report available to customers, alongside the platform's certification portfolio
